Messages.Author: Uriel
Messages.Body:
They might seem kind of elementary but:

1. Can a combatant opt not to strike at all (e.g. when his opponent
played a Blood of Acid)? And if yes, can he then declare additional
strikes?

2. Can the same AM or RA cards be played more than once, during the
same action to increase his stealth or intercept?

3. The NoRepeatAction is a tournament only ruling?

No. [6.4.3] Moot.

> 2. Can the same AM or RA cards be played more than once, during the

No. [1.6.3.2] [1.6.3.5]

It is a V:EKN constructed tournament "special floor rule". It is not
part of the basic rules of the game, although it is sometimes used
outside of V:EKN tournaments as a house rule.

Messages.Author: Santiago
Messages.Body:
In article <3B465F00...@white-wolf.com>, LSJ
<vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:

>> 2. Can the same AM or RA cards be played more than once, during the
>> same action to increase his stealth or intercept?
>
>No. [1.6.3.2] [1.6.3.5]

Actually, they can be used more than once per action, but only once
per minion. Thus, multiple minions can each use superior Cloak the
Gathering on the acting minion.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>>> 2. Can the same AM or RA cards be played more than once, during the
>>> same action to increase his stealth or intercept?
>>
>>No. [1.6.3.2] [1.6.3.5]
>
> Actually, they can be used more than once per action, but only once
>per minion. Thus, multiple minions can each use superior Cloak the
>Gathering on the acting minion.

I think the original question implied that only one minion was using AM's or
RA's.

But yes it is true that multiple minions can each use superior Cloaks or
inferior Shrouds.

Also, don't forget about Mask of a Thousand Faces. If Minion A bleeds and plays
superior Lost in Crowds, the action is at +2 stealth. If Minion B then plays
inferior Mask to continue the action, Minion B can also play a superior Lost in
Crowds for additional stealth.

Halcyan 2
